text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh! And guess what, Mom? I got
some fans!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I even got a letter that said, "Your
running left a
real impression on me!"
Heh, it reminds me of how
popular Dad
was!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Huh? Sorry, Mom, the signal's
cutting out.
What did you say?
...Uh-huh.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! That's right! ♪ I'm everyone's
beloved lil'
girly! I'll keep running til the
day I make my
dreams come true and
come home with a bunch
of trophies!
Hehe! ♪
